title: The Gate of Kar-Durim
rumor: The Gate of Kar-Durim. Dwarven tradition holds that the ancient high gate of Kar-Durim remains standing somewhere in the mountains, its doors sealed since the fall of the Lost Holds. The gate is said to bear the names of every king who ruled within, and to possess mechanisms that no living smith can reproduce. Some claim that the doors open for a single hour each year.
first_lead: Blackpick families preserve fragments of old maps describing the approach to the high gate.
